tools.name: academyocean_list_academies
tools.description: List the academies in the account with their learner counts, publish state and custom domain. Good first call to find an academy id. Action: academies.

tools.name: academyocean_list_courses
tools.description: List the courses in the academy with their id, slug, description, group flag and SCORM flag. Use the id in the course tools. Action: courses.

tools.name: academyocean_list_teams
tools.description: List the teams in the academy. Set include_course_assignments to add the courses each team is assigned. Action: getTeams.

tools.name: academyocean_list_learners
tools.description: List learners registered in the academy with their score, lesson counts, last login and country. Filter by one email. Action: learners.

tools.name: academyocean_get_learner_progress
tools.description: Return one learner's progress in every course or group, with a breakdown of each lesson and quiz (passed, score, times). Action: courseProgress.

tools.name: academyocean_learners_registered
tools.description: List learners who registered on one date (with an operator such as >=) or within a start and end date range. Dates are UTC. Action: learnersRegisteredAt.

tools.name: academyocean_learners_repeated_logins
tools.description: List learners who logged in more than once, optionally within a date range (UTC). Action: learnersRepeatedLogIns.

tools.name: academyocean_learners_completed_course
tools.description: List learners who completed one course. Use the course id or URL slug from the course list. Action: learnersCourseComplete.

tools.name: academyocean_course_progress_by_learners
tools.description: Return every learner's progress in one course, page by page. Give course_id or course_slug (course_id wins if both are set). Action: learnersProgressByCourse.

tools.name: academyocean_learners_by_score
tools.description: List learners whose score matches a value, for example >= 80. Action: learnersWithScore.

tools.name: academyocean_passive_learners
tools.description: List learners who registered but never opened a lesson. Action: passiveLearners.

tools.name: academyocean_learners_churn_at_content
tools.description: List learners who stopped progressing at one content item (lesson or quiz) of a course. Action: learnersChurnAtContent.

tools.name: academyocean_learners_by_country
tools.description: List learners from one country by its ISO code, for example NL. Action: learnersFromCountry.

tools.name: academyocean_learner_certificates
tools.description: List the certificates issued to one learner, with course name, issue date and PDF or image links. Action: certificates.

tools.name: academyocean_learner_variables
tools.description: Return custom variable values for learners. Pass an object keyed by learner email, each value a list of variable names. System fields are not returned. Action: getLearnerVariable.

tools.name: academyocean_learner_quiz_statistics
tools.description: Return detailed quiz attempts for learners. Pass an object keyed by learner email, each value a list of encoded quiz ids. Includes scores, timing and per-question answers. Action: getLearnersQuizStatistic.

tools.name: academyocean_check_learner_invites
tools.description: Check whether invitations exist for some emails, and whether each one has been used. Returns one entry per email. Action: checkLearnerInvite.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: academyocean_list_learners, academyocean_learners_completed_course, academyocean_learner_certificates, academyocean_learner_variables, academyocean_learner_quiz_statistics, academyocean_check_learner_invites · Public sink: academyocean_list_academies, academyocean_list_learners, academyocean_learner_variables, academyocean_learner_quiz_statistics, academyocean_check_learner_invites.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: academyocean_list_learners, academyocean_learners_completed_course, academyocean_learner_certificates, academyocean_learner_variables, academyocean_learner_quiz_statistics, academyocean_check_learner_invites · Public sink: academyocean_list_academies, academyocean_list_learners, academyocean_learner_variables, academyocean_learner_quiz_statistics, academyocean_check_learner_invites

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
